THE PROBLEM
YOUR KITCHEN ISN’T WORKING FOR YOU ANYMORE

You’ve spent years in this kitchen. You know every squeaky hinge, every drawer that sticks, every cabinet door that doesn’t quite close right. Maybe the kids are grown and gone, and now it’s time to finally make this space yours. Or maybe your family has outgrown a kitchen that was never quite right to begin with.

Either way, you deserve a kitchen that works as hard as you do—and looks beautiful doing it.

We’ve Helped Hundreds of Families Fall Back in Love With Their Kitchens

We understand that remodeling your kitchen feels like a big, complicated, expensive undertaking. You’ve probably heard the horror stories—contractors who disappear for weeks, projects that drag on for months, budgets that spiral out of control.

That’s not how we work.

At 3 Day Cabinet Pros we’ve spent 7 years doing one thing exceptionally well: transforming kitchens with quality cabinets, honest pricing, and a process so efficient it will genuinely surprise you. We offer three cabinet lines to fit a range of budgets, and we’ll help you find the perfect fit for your home and your investment.

Our customers don’t wait months. Most are enjoying their new kitchen within two to three weeks.

What People Say About Our Company?

OUR SIMPLE, TRANSPARENT PROCESS

Quality Shouldn’t Take Forever

Free In-Home Design Consultation

We come to you. We measure your space, listen to your vision, and walk you through our three cabinet collections—all with honest, upfront pricing. No pressure, no surprises.

02
Choose Your Cabinets and Confirm Your Design

We present your custom design with a detailed quote. You choose the style, finish, and features that fit your home and your budget. Once you approve, we handle everything from ordering to scheduling.

03
Professional Installation

Our experienced installation team arrives on time and treats your home with respect. Most kitchen cabinet projects are completed in just one to two days of installation.

 

04
You Love Your Kitchen

We do a final walkthrough together to make sure every detail is exactly right. We don’t consider the job done until you’re completely satisfied.

 

A BETTER WAY TO REMODEL
Ready to Finally Get the Kitchen You Deserve?

If you’ve been putting off your kitchen remodel because you thought it would take too long, cost too much, or be too disruptive—we’d love to change your mind.

Schedule a free, no-pressure design consultation and see how fast and easy a kitchen transformation can be.

Schedule Your Free Consultation

CABINET COLLECTIONS

We Don’t Just Install Cabinets. We Show Up, Do It Right, And Leave Your Home Better Than We Found It.

Get a Free Estimate
FOUNDER
LIAM MCCORMACK

Our founder, Liam McCormack didn’t take the traditional path. He left college after a year — not because he couldn’t hack it, but because he looked around at where that path was leading and decided it wasn’t where he wanted to go.

What he did have was a lifetime of hands-on experience. Growing up in a family of entrepreneurs, Liam was fixing plumbing and hanging entry doors at age 12. Work ethics and problem-solving weren’t things he learned in a classroom. They were things he lived.

He found his way back to the trades, built relationships with clients and crews, and eventually built what is now 3 Day Cabinet Pros and More. He’ll tell you it’s been the most rewarding journey of his life — and that they’re just getting started.

71

Hundreds of families served
The Lesson That Shaped Everything

Early in his career, Liam learned a lesson the hard way — the kind of lesson that sticks.
His crew was already running slightly behind on a project. The plumber had to leave for his next job and couldn’t return until the following week. There was a sink to hook up. One of the cabinet crew had some basic plumbing experience. The temptation was obvious: just have him do it. Get it done. Stay on schedule.
He did. One trap wasn’t seated correctly. Water spilled across the floor.
The mess was caught quickly. The damage was minimal. But the lesson was permanent.

Slow down to do it right — even when it’s not easy. Especially when it’s not easy.

That single experience became the foundation of how 3 Day Cabinet Pros operates today. Cutting corners doesn’t save time. It doubles it. Taking the easy road serves no one — not the client, not the crew, not the company.

	
Slow down to do it right — even when it's not easy. Especially when it's not easy.
— Liam McCormack
AN HONEST WORD
What Drives Liam Crazy About This Industry.

Here’s something Liam will say out loud that most contractors won’t:

A long timeline is not a sign of quality. It’s a sign of a problem.

When a kitchen remodel drags on for six, seven, or nine weeks, it doesn’t mean the contractor is being meticulous. It means something broke down — the wrong people on the job, poor management, or expectations that were never set correctly before the first cabinet was touched.

Quality shouldn’t take forever. That’s not a tagline. It’s a standard.

Quality Shouldn’t Take Forever

HOW WE OPERATE.
01
The crew that installs your cabinets are our team members — not subcontractors.

Cabinet installation is the foundation of every kitchen project. 3 Day Cabinet Pros keeps that work entirely in-house, with a team that has been together for an average of five-plus years. That’s not an accident. That’s a culture.

02
For specialty trades, we only work with people we know.

Plumbing, electrical, countertops — these require licensed specialists. Every subcontractor 3 Day Cabinet Pros works with has been a trusted partner for at least two years. No strangers in your home.

03
When something goes wrong, we don’t hide it.

Things happen on job sites. When they do, Liam’s approach is simple: communicate the facts, skip the blame, and work out a plan with the client. Most problems on a job aren’t anyone’s fault. But they are always 3 Day Cabinet Pros’ responsibility — to fix it, facilitate it, or find someone who can.

Families Served

WHAT LIAM WANTS YOU TO FEEL
When The Job is Done…

When the job is done, Liam wants one thing:

He wants you to feel like you could invite him over for dinner.

And if you do — he’ll probably say yes.

That’s the kind of contractor he is. That’s the kind of company 3 Day Cabinet Pros is. If that sounds like the person you want in your home, let’s talk.

Get a Free Estimate
OUR TEAM
Meet The 3 Day Cabinet Pros team

At 3 Day Cabinet Pros, we specialize in transforming homes across Machesney Park, Rockford, and surrounding areas with exceptional kitchen and bathroom remodels. We understand the importance of clear communication, transparent pricing, and timely project completion, ensuring your vision comes to life with quality craftsmanship and minimal disruption. Experience the difference of a trusted local general contractor.

Meet Our Team

We believe that exceptional results stem from an exceptional team. Our skilled professionals bring unparalleled experience and dedication to every project, ensuring the quality workmanship, clear communication, and reliability you deserve. Get to know the experts committed to transforming your vision into reality.

Your Kitchen Should Be the Favorite Room in Your House. Right Now, It Probably Isn’t.

Most homeowners put up with a kitchen that doesn’t work for years — because they’re afraid of what a remodel will actually look like.
The mess. The timeline. The contractor who disappears. The budget that doubles. We built 3 Day Cabinet Pros specifically to solve that problem.

Schedule Your Free Design Consultation
See Our Cabinet Collections
The Problem We Solve 

A kitchen remodel is one of the biggest investments you’ll make in your home. It’s also one of the most stressful — because most contractors treat your house like a job site and your timeline like a suggestion.

You’ve heard the stories. Six weeks become ten. The crew shows up three days a week. Nobody answers the phone. You’re eating takeout for two months and still don’t have a kitchen.

That’s not how we work.

Why 3 Day Cabinet Pros Is Different

We set expectations before we touch a single cabinet.

Before any work begins, you’ll have a detailed scope, a clear budget breakdown, and a realistic timeline. No vague estimates. No surprise change orders. No “we’ll figure it out as we go.”


Our installation crew works for us — not a subcontractor list.

The people installing your cabinets are our full-time employees. They’ve been with us an average of five-plus years. They show up when they’re supposed to, they work clean, and they take pride in what they build. Because it has their name on it too.


Quality shouldn't take forever.

A long timeline is not a sign of craftsmanship. It’s a sign of poor planning. We’ve completed hundreds of kitchen remodels and we know exactly what it takes to do the job right — and do it on schedule.


When something comes up, we tell you immediately.

Things happen on job sites. When they do, we communicate the facts, skip the blame, and work out a plan together. Most problems aren’t anyone’s fault. But they are always our responsibility.

OUR SIMPLE, TRANSPARENT PROCESS

Four steps. Precise results.

01
We Listen First

We start with a conversation about your vision, your budget, and your timeline. We’ll tell you honestly what’s achievable — and what isn’t. No pressure. No sales pitch.

02
We Build Your Plan

Our team develops a detailed design plan with layout options, material selections, and a transparent cost breakdown. You’ll know exactly what every dollar is doing before we schedule a start date.

03
We Get to Work

Our in-house crew manages every detail of the installation. We work efficiently, keep your home clean, and minimize disruption to your daily life. You’ll get regular updates so you always know where things stand.

04
We Walk Through It Together

When the job is done, we do a thorough walkthrough with you — not a handshake at the door. Every detail gets reviewed. Every question gets answered. We don’t consider the job finished until you do.

OUR ADVANTAGES
What You Get

	

A kitchen designed around how your family actually lives


	

Precise cabinet installation by a crew that does this every day


	

Countertop fitting that’s measured, cut, and installed to last


	

A finished space that looks exactly like what you approved — not a close approximation

THE RESULT

When we’re done, you’ll have a kitchen you want to show people. One that works the way a kitchen should. And a contractor you’d actually invite over for dinner.
(That’s not a figure of speech. Our clients do it all the time.)

The Right Countertop Can Transform a Kitchen. The Wrong Installation Can Ruin It.

Countertops are the first thing people notice when they walk into your kitchen. They’re what your guests comment on. They’re what you touch a hundred times a day.

Getting them right isn’t just about choosing a beautiful material. It’s about precise measurement, expert fabrication, and an installation that fits perfectly — the first time.

Schedule Your Free Design Consultation
The Problem With Most Countertop Installations

Here’s where a lot of contractors cut corners:
Measurement is rushed. Templating is imprecise. The fabricator gets numbers that are close — but not exact. And when the countertop arrives, there’s a gap at the wall, a seam that doesn’t line up, or an edge profile that doesn’t match what you selected.

Fixing it means pulling the slab, going back to the fabricator, and waiting again. Meanwhile your kitchen is out of commission and your patience is gone.
Precision isn’t optional with countertops. It’s the whole job.

HOW WE HANDLE COUNTERTOPS DIFFERENTLY

We work with specialists we actually know.

Countertop fabrication and installation require dedicated expertise and specialized equipment. We don’t pretend otherwise. We work with a trusted countertop partner we’ve collaborated with for over two years — craftsmen we’ve vetted, worked alongside, and would recommend to our own families.
What that means for you: you get a specialist doing specialist work, coordinated and managed by a team that takes full responsibility for the outcome.


We manage the whole project — not just our part of it.

One of the biggest frustrations homeowners have with remodels is the finger-pointing. The contractor blames the fabricator. The fabricator blames the measurements. Nobody takes ownership.
That’s not how we operate. When you hire 3 Day Cabinet Pros, we will coordinate every trade involved in your project. If something isn’t right, it’s our responsibility to make it right — regardless of who did what.


Measurement is treated like the critical step it is.

Before your countertop is fabricated, we ensure templating is done with precision. The right measurements taken once are infinitely better than the wrong measurements corrected twice.


Quality shouldn't take forever.

A countertop installation that drags on is a planning failure. We schedule fabrication and installation in the right sequence, so your countertops arrive when your project is ready for them — not a week early sitting in a garage, and not a week late holding everything else up.

YOUR OPTIONS

Every kitchen and bathroom is different. Every homeowner has different priorities. We’ll help you find the material that fits your lifestyle, your aesthetic, and your budget.

Quartz

Engineered for consistency and durability. Non-porous, low maintenance, and available in a wide range of colors and patterns. An excellent choice for busy kitchens.

Granite

Natural stone with unique character in every slab. No two granite countertops are identical. Durable, heat-resistant, and timeless.

Laminate

Modern laminate has come a long way. Today’s options offer the look of stone or wood at a fraction of the cost — and are more durable than most people expect.

Not sure which material is right for your project? That’s exactly what the consultation is for.

Precision Fabrication and Installation

Templating is done carefully. Fabrication is handled by our trusted specialist partner. Installation is coordinated to fit seamlessly into your overall project timeline. We manage every handoff so nothing falls through the cracks.

We Walk Through It Together

Every seam. Every edge. Every cutout for your sink and fixtures. We review it all with you before we consider the job done. If anything isn’t exactly right, we handle it — no debate, no deflection.

Not Every Kitchen Needs a Full Remodel. But Some Do. 
Here’s How to Know the Difference.

One of the most common questions we get from homeowners is simple: should I reface my cabinets or replace them entirely?
It’s a great question — and the honest answer can save you tens of thousands of dollars.

Or it can save you from making a decision you’ll regret in two years. We’d rather give you the truth upfront than sell you the wrong solution.

Schedule Your Free Design Consultation
See Our Cabinet Collections
Here’s A Quick, 2-Minute Explanation
Two Excellent Options. Two Different Problems.

Cabinet refacing and full cabinet replacement are both excellent options. They just solve different problems.

Refacing makes sense when your kitchen layout works and your cabinet boxes are in good shape — you just want a dramatically different look. Replacement makes sense when the bones of your kitchen need to change — the layout, the storage, the structure itself.

The mistake most homeowners make is assuming they need the more expensive option. The mistake some contractors make is letting them.

Use the guide below to get an honest read on where you stand.

The Side-by-Side Guide

	
Option A
Reface Your Cabinets If...

	
Your cabinet boxes are solid

Open your cabinet doors and look at the frames built into your walls. If the wood is firm, there’s no water damage, warping, or soft spots — your boxes have years of life left in them. Refacing makes perfect sense.


	
You're happy with your kitchen layout

Do your cabinets give you enough storage? Does the flow of your kitchen work for how you actually cook and live? If the answer is yes — and you just want it to look completely different — refacing delivers that transformation for a fraction of the cost.


	
You want results without the disruption

A full cabinet replacement means demolition, debris, and a kitchen that’s out of commission for weeks. Refacing means new doors, new drawer fronts, new hardware, and new veneers — installed efficiently, with far less mess and far less downtime.


	
You want to maximize your budget

Quality refacing typically costs 40 to 60 percent less than full cabinet replacement. If your goal is to make a kitchen that looks brand new without a brand new price tag, refacing is one of the smartest investments you can make in your home.


	
You're preparing to sell

Buyers notice kitchens. Updated cabinets dramatically improve first impressions and perceived value. If your boxes are sound, refacing gives you maximum visual impact for minimum investment — exactly what you want before listing.


	
Option B
Replace Your Cabinets If...

	
Your cabinet boxes are damaged

Water damage, warping, soft wood, or structural deterioration means the boxes themselves need to go. Refacing damaged boxes is like putting new siding on a house with a failing foundation. It won’t hold up — and it’s not something we’d recommend.


	
Your kitchen layout isn't working

If you need more storage, different cabinet placement, an island where there wasn’t one, or a fundamentally different flow — refacing can’t solve that. You need new cabinets in new positions. That’s a replacement conversation.


	
You're doing a full kitchen renovation anyway

If you’re already replacing countertops, moving plumbing, updating appliances, and reconfiguring the space — it often makes sense to replace cabinets as part of that larger project rather than reface and remodel around them.


	
Your cabinets are very old with outdated construction

Some older cabinet boxes simply weren’t built to modern standards. If the construction is poor, the materials are failing, or the interior functionality is beyond saving — starting fresh is the smarter long-term investment.


	
You want a completely different layout or size

Refacing works with what’s there. If you want taller cabinets, deeper cabinets, or cabinets in entirely different locations — replacement is the path forward.

Still Not Sure?

That’s completely normal. Most homeowners aren’t — and that’s exactly what the consultation is for.

We’ll look at your cabinets honestly, tell you what we see, and give you a straight answer about which direction makes more sense for your situation and your budget. No pressure toward the more expensive option. No upselling.

Just an honest assessment from someone who does this every day.

(And if refacing is the right answer, we’ll tell you that — even though a full remodel costs more.)

No spam. Just a useful tool from people who’d rather help you make the right decision than the expensive one.
